text: it used be one of my favorite game. but right now as a free to play player it's not even playable. the developers only making it suitable for the pay to win players by adding card level 16 and launching heroes. that's why so many people are leaving the game right now. and I'm also thinking to stop playing myself. I don't know what their goal is. but one thing for sure, if you can't keep your players satisfied you'll lose every goal of yours.

This game is extremely pay to win, which makes it unfun to play. Very often, you will encounter players with troops 2 levels higher or their King Tower's 2 levels higher, which are unbeatable 95% of the time. This leaves you with 2 options, invest money to upgrade your cards to equal the other players, or grind for weeks, possibly months to have an equal playing field. But then, once you do and start climbing, you will run into the same issue again. I wish I could write more about the game

As a fan of supercell I thought I would give this a go. Enjoyed it a lot at first, fun units and strategies, but later the matchmaking goes of a cliff. Matching against players with troops/cards 3-4 levels higher? What's the point, just give them a free win and don't waste anyone's time? The odd one like this would be forgiven, but it's not and I like my time. Uninstalled. Events are ok, but some better guidance as to what items are would be good (i buttons like in CoC).

Great game, extremely fun. The only problem is that it's pay to win. People who spend money on the game end up way higher level than you, and your cards in the end just won't cut it. The game says it's 'pay to progress' but you can't progress if you keep losing to people who have paid, and if you can't progress then you will never have a chance of beating them unless you pay.

high reviews for this money grab game is either from those prepared to spend significant sums of money or those new to the game. Thought I'd update again after the introduction of the level 15 cards and evolution cards. Again as has been each update, it's just another money grab. They've boosted a set of cards that are impossibly difficult to upgrade unless you pay £5.99 each... These cards are boosted to such a degree you're pretty much going to lose if you don't have one and the opponent does!

WORST UPDATE EVER!!!! I've played this game for about 4 years, was always a great time killer and was interesting. Since the last update, battle matches are unfair and the chances of winning a match are ridiculously low. It's made the game boring. I have pretty high level cards but I can't even fill my chest slots since the update. I've bought the battle passes each time, but I won't be spending any more money if things aren't fixed.... I'll be uninstalling instead, which is a massive shame 😔

Clash Royale is, and has alwaye been, a fun game to compete with other players or just pass time. I have played this game for 3 years now and I still find it fun. The main reasons I rated the game 4 stars rather than 5 are that at high levels progression becomes incredibly slow unless you pay. Obviously it makes sense that progression slows down, but in this case it is way worse than it should be. The other reason it lost a star is because the new matchmaking system is ridiculous.

Done done and done with this game, I recently installed this again thinking I'd give it another shot. There is no change whatsoever.....in fact it's got worse. Such unfair gameplay. First of all the matchmaking is pathetic, it's pay to win. Unless you are willing to pay loads of money to buy the best characters you are not going to level up and you will lose every match (so frustrating 😡) The elixir is tampered with on certain matches. The fun has gone from it. FIX IT SUPERCELL!

Maybe the developers have given up on the game, but why can't they see the problem with a character when almost everyone has it in their deck. Firecrackers everywhere, all of the time. The game needs balanced. There's other favourites but you simply can't play a game without there constantly being a firecracker in play. She's too cheap and her damage is too strong. Oh, but let's make her evolve, that'll be a great idea 😆

Used to be one of my favorites, but I feel like it's slowly dying. Favorite content creators have slowly stopped creating content because it stopped getting views. Feels like the company just wants cash grab after cash grab. Used to have a good sense of progression with the monthly pass, but now the value of passes and shop deals have gone down drastically. The game is free to play, but if you are you will start progressing real slow after the first few arenas. I really hope it gets better.

Decent game, if you have never played this game before its OK at first and I do like the card feature. However, after a while it gets very repetitive, the war system isn't great and the chests are way to expensive considering you might not even get a legendry. The wait to open a chest is wayyyyyyy too long, like I said it's OK at first but overall its very repetitive and you don't get that sense of achievement after moving up a arena.

Warning: recent changes have ruined the game, it is completely different to previous years. It's very sad to see one of the best games from the 2010s, of any genre, be tainted by corporate greed - to such an extent that it is now not only Pay To Win, but Pay To Play. Supercell have been monetising the game to within an inch of its life, with the introduction of Level 15, plus card evolutions - you now can't even compete in higher sections of the main game mode unless you spend a lot of money

I'm sorry to say that this game is no longer brilliant. It is definitely aimed at pay to win players. The December update has made it impossible to upgrade cards by trading because both players need a trade token and who'd waste one of those on a trade they didn't particularly want. Also higher players tend not to donate cards anymore as they have to pay to do so once they're max level. Terrible. Fix this. This was my 5 star review:"I download a lot of games but end up uninstalling them as I get bored. I have played this everyday for almost a year and have not been bored the entire time. You can play as much or as little as you like and works well whether you want a free to play game or a pay to win game. Brilliant."

This game is great it runs on most devices with no lag (maybe internet lag but nothing they can do to fix that) and has action packed matches what last up to 5 mins. You can play the game without spending anything but the game tempts you into it. I have spent maybe £10 on it and I'm at a pretty high trophy count missing only 2 cards. One problem is smurfs. Every 3-5 games you will encounter someone 3 levels above you and there is nothing you can do. Anyway great game would recommend!

Matchmaking rigged for you to lose to make you buy gems. Endless microtransactions. Just a few of the problems with this mobile version of an EA game. When this was released a couple years back, it was absolutely amazing and supercell made a masterpiece. Now, all they care about is money. Making a battle pass that gives huge competitive advantage to those who buy it. Matchmaking that puts me up against level 10s and every now and then 11s when I'm level 9 with higher level cards. Ridiculous.

For a real time strategy game you'd expect a more balanced troop levelling system. The end game drop off means without spending a dime, it'll take you at least a year for you to get legendaries to level 3 and epics to level 7. However, due to the nature of this game, it is extremely tempting for people to pay for diamonds, pay for chests (which still not guaranteed a legendary card). I do not recommend this game to anyone since you will end up wasting your money for no reward.

The game is great, I play it as often as I have breaks...which is a lot! However, since the recent update, I have notice that some of my cards have been 'replaced or better yet...removed. Almost lime some of my progress has been removed. Cards I had, I no longer have. Please fix. Over a year now, and still waiting for some sort of reply/response from the developers. It's clear they are working on the game, as there are updates. But at the same time, clear they read the comment. Typical.

Similar to the other reviews I've seen, I've had this game pretty much since release and it has become noticeable how pay to win the game has become. You can reach the higher rankings simply by spending money when it used to take skill and strategy. Still a fun game, but not something to get too invested in if like me you don't wish to spend money.

It's a good game but hard to be a casual player. If you want to play for free, there comes a point where you can't hope to compete because your cards are too underpowered. Spending real money to upgrade your cards is a waste of time for the average player because you're looking at literally thousands of pounds to max out your account, at which point you're up against the big boys, and essentially in the same boat as when your cards were underpowered, except you've blown all your cash.

after playing on and off for a significant amount of time I've decided how I feel about this game, its fun but its flawed to the point where even casual play becomes a chore. The game is pay to win at its core, to win games you need to level your cards, cards are leveled using gold and extra cards, cards can be bought using gold, gold can be bought using gems and gems are bought using real money. it quickly becomes unenjoyable as you wont progress very quickly without paying.

Im really fed up of the way supercell are making the game pay to win again. It was at a point where as pay to skip it was acceptable, but as I got to the upper leagues and they add another level? The people that can afford to spend stupid amounts on this will beat me with higher level cards, though they wouldn't beat me with same level. You should only ever pay for aesthetics in games like this. Feel ripped off. I have played as long as CR has been around and spent more than I could afford.

This used to be a 5 star game. The update to level 15 and card evolutions makes the gap between high spenders and no/low spenders so great that there's not really any point playing unless you're going to full on whale. I've given it a few months, thinking "maybe it'll get better and I'll get used to it" but there's no getting around it, a player with level 14 cards is simply outpowered by a player who spends and has a bunch of evolved level 15 cards.

The game is really fun, addictive, and well-made. But sometimes it feels like you need to spend money to progress faster — especially when facing opponents who boosted their cards with purchases. That doesn’t feel fair. In the end, this game is either about patience and smart strategy, or paying to progress quickly.

Let me completely honest. this game has fallen off so much it's unreal, it seems supercell is trying it's best to ruin this game for anyone who doesn't spend money on microtransactions. it's like call of duty all over again but on mobile. it is pathetic and scummy, it used to be bearable, you used to have so much things that would help you level up your cards as a free to play, I have been playing this game for around 4 years now- I recently unistalled it because the changes were too much.

Be warned. This game heavily involves either countering or being countered by the enemy. Rarely does this game involve a proper fair 1v1 scenario. I have played this game for over a year now and the only reason i am still playing is because of the time i have invested into it. I do not recommend spending money onto this game since most of the deals are just overpriced. However, I do enjoy the variety of different characters that are available to choose from aswell as the war day gamemode.

Every update makes the game worse. What used to be a game of strategy has become a game with no skill due to the inclusion of evolutions. Furthermore, every update makes progression more difficult unless you spend a large amount of money. Do not download this app. They do not care about the player experience only about money. And as with my experience, it has only gotten less fun throughout the years and is now unplayable.

This game used to be really fun, I had a blast around 2021 - 2022. But, recently... with all the Broken Evo's and Broken Hero's, Free to play players just can't keep up. (They are attempting to make the game better so you can get cards you want with gems... but it just isn't enough.) If you wanna play for free, I'd recommend any other game, as you'll just get annoyed. But if you like spending money... go ahead.

I play this game every day and I've made good progress without spending a penny. I'm on Level 11 with nearly 13,000 points. However, the game is plagued with connection issues. I can guarantee to lose the first game of every day because the app takes so long to connect to the server. By the time I'm into a game, it's practically over. Subsequent games connect perfectly normally. Other than that problem, the game is well balanced and fun to play

The game is fun, and I can see myself playing it for a while especially whilst I'm travelling. However, there are server side issues that really need to be looked at. Although I have full bars and my connection is stable via data and WiFi, my games have a habit of losing connection, ruining the overall experience. I would say the game is definitely worth giving a shot, I just hope this issues gets dealt with soon.

The issue is as many have mentioned that the beginning is very enjoyable up until you have spent enough time to be hooked at the game. At which point "matchmaking" only ever puts you against players that have a perfect counter deck, or are completely maxed out, in other words telling you "you can be that good too just buy them chests so you can get maxed out too" as getting chests the free to play way is incredibly slow. Conceptually I love the game, but supercell is worse than EA as a company.

Expect to have to pay if you don't want to be playing for 3 years to get a maxed deck. Once you're there, though, it is fun, I must admit. The party mode they recently added keeps gamemodes in cycle, which is nice. Ladder is surprisingly balanced currently, though war is getting stale. Overall a solid 4; it's the only game I've kept installed over new devices.

The greed of supercell is leading the game to its demise. Loved the game, stopped playing it due to consistent intentional im-balance changes, in order to make you spend more money on stuff. Not to mention, they use an algorithm which gives you different prices for the same offers, based on how much are you most likely going to spend. It is absolutely disgusting. "Thank you" Supercell for ruining the one game that I liked....

Maxed 90% of cards, only spent ~$20 on this game over the last 5 years of playing it. The other reviews are right in saying this game can be difficult or unfair at certain levels. You definitely run into the $1000 whales in this game, and it's at every single arena level. If you like some strategy, and can deal with days where you lose every match, this is the game for you.

This game is fun up until you start to make actual progress. Once you get into the higher trophy leagues and start to do the more challenging event battles the cheating is just out of this world. I've played for a little over 3 years and I haven't had this issue until the recent months, ironically after I saw the fair play junk. I don't know if supercell cares or not but until they fix the cheating the game really is ruined for me.

The game was good about two years ago but since then there has been no innovation. There are 3-4 deck archetypes with a few interchangeable cards. New cards are basically slightly different versions of original cards. They balance cards in a way the prevents creativity. Some of the funnest cards they have created are nerfed into oblivion for fear of a little bit of something different creeping its way into the meta. As a result you get a very stale game.

ever since the last update or 2, sometimes the game begins to have some serious performance degradation all of a sudden and my device freezes with no way of getting back in game or doing anything whatsoever. I have to restart my phone whenever this happens. This is extremely annoying when it happens in a clan war game. Another very annoying recent bug is when a unit is selected, sometimes its drop zone is fixed and I can't undo the drop or move it. The game is becoming unplayable...

Game is fun, the card level system is horrible and breaks all the balance but there are a few game modes now which ignore this that dampens the problem. Main issue there is no purchase privacy, if you purchase the pass which is the best value for money in the game your name gets turned gold for everyone to see and it's announced in clan chat. There's no option to disable this so good luck getting anything of value for your money without a high privacy breach

RIP Clash Royal. Newly branded Crash Royale. The new update was what I feared...Pay to play instead of play for free. I appreciate supercell aren't a charity and need to make their money somehow, but £4.99/$4.99 for a season pass is just unnecessarily extortionate. Also, the lag, fps and server speed has become painfully slow making the game, in many cases, unplayable. What a shame, this was my favourite game to play for the past 3 years... time to take up chess

What I think after opening a chest: Wow, that was underwhelming. At least I can actually play the game again. Seriously, if you want to progress in the game, you need to level up your cards. How do you get those cards? Open a chest every 3+ hours for no guaranteed card in your deck. This means that if you want a reward for PLAYING THE GAME, you have to wait 3+ hours(unless your willing to throw gems(money) at the game). The actual gameplay is pretty good, if not a little infuriating in itself

I love the game - when it loads. Most of the time when I try to load it I either end up staring at a black screen, or the progress bar freezes at 50%. It's a shame, when it does actually load I have a good time, the gameplay is fun etc, but it's really let down by not loading most of the times I try to play.

A con!!!!!!!!! This game may seem great at the start but as you go up the levels you will start to see the patterns appearing, it is definitely fixed by the game designers so you don't reach the top. If you see through the facade there is no point playing and definitely not pay for gems!!! P.s they never answer any emails so your on your own!!!!

Another great game from Supercell, been playing on and off since game was released and it's come a long way. Beware extremely addictive. The players who spend most money have a massive advantage and it's not possible to keep up with them if you're a free player. That being said if it wasn't for those who pay we couldn't play for free . Note If you do want to pay n play it's quite expensive.

bored to tears of this game, who thinks of these games, it's the worst type of grindy game, that wants to hook you into buying upgrades, this is a tax on kids, $900 million and counting, don't waste your money you will get to a level where you can't progress any further so don't start it in the first place, problem solved, constantly matching me against op opponents makes it impossible to progress, upgrade process of troops is biblically slow, 2 days is all I could stand, deleted.

It would be 0 but sadly I can't do that. I downloaded The game again after some time, and I realised that my Account had been lost so I made a new one in order to Message some helpers in order to recover my account. I logged back on to see if there was a reply, but I was banned for a month cause of "phishing attempts". This is so stupid. I even emailed but all I got was automatic replies.

The concept is amazing, but the game just feels like who is willing to sacrifice any morals to win, with the amount of cheap and unfair combos it's no longer a game I would recommend anyone plays if they want to have fun, the only time I ever have fun is with the draft game mode when it comes out, which still sucks when you or the opponent gets a broken card. Also recommend preventing players from fighting opponents way higher levels, I'm lvl 11 and don't enjoy fighting lvl13 or 14.

Would've been five stars if it didn't keep closing / not working in matches and matches only; whenever I place the gaint snowball it closes and I subsequently lose the match. This is gappening WAY too often. (I'm not arena 8 and don't/ can't get the giant snowball yet and I get it in drafts or clan wars.) Otherwise a very good and tatical game which I recommend getting. It's nice how (rarely) you can get a good deal (eg: two legendary chests for £2!) Also make the trainer difficultly optional!

Even though you will never read this, I need to get it off my chest. People with way higher levels at the beginning, basically with a whole different roster, you just can't call it strategy. People spend like hours basically grinding chests so they can get top of the class troops and high leveled ones, having the entire advantage. Overall, the match-making is absolutely terrible, shocking and honestly it's one of the worst if you have to wait just to " hope " for something good.

Great game, play all the time with my friends and family, also best game to pass the time on a long-haul flights or long drive journeys or to play in your spare time It says their are ads but the only time there is if you want them. No lagging It's a shame you have you have to have wifi - if you didnt need it then it wudve been a five star

I have been playing this game for almost 7 years, I still remember trophy racing with my friends at school, and I have been pretty much free to play the entire time, I got the pass every once in a while but that's it, I love this game; however I feel betrayed by the developers as during the last few years I've seen a game I've loved be turned into a money grab clearly shown by: decreasing the rewards from the pass, introducing level 15 and evolutions, obviously terrible offers in the shop.

If you don't pay you don't win. I've been a clan leader for three years and everyone in my clan refuses to pay for chests, etc. So we are all stuck at the same level and there is no way to improve without spending money. It can take a year to update a single card because the process is so heavily weighted to p2w. Used to be great, now is just frustrating. They've even introduced a £5 a month scam to get you to spend more money. The people who created the app must live in solid gold houses!

This game poses as a free to play game but later on you are at a severe disadvantage as others have paid and therefore have a significant advantage. It has really fallen off in the last couple of months (especially since the king 14 update) and is not fun at this point. They made an event to make people spend all their coins and then sent king 14 out. Making lots of players spend money to stay on par with everyone else. Unless you are willing to shell out lots of money I wouldn't recommend.

Game is far less enjoyable than it used to be, that is because now there are so many characters with different abilities that a strong element of luck is needed that your deck has the right characteristics to have a good battle with opposing deck. In the past far more skill was needed and the game although frustrating at times really hooked you in. The game already had a good revenue stream, its pure greed of the developers. The long term enjoyment of the game is gone.

Terrible "update". Less for your money and they increase the cost. Limit ladder to one game mode which has doubled the time for a game to finish. I've bought the pass since I've started playing. Now I won't pay and I'm questioning whether to keep playing. This update is clearly a money grab and in my opinion they've pushed it too far and got greedy. Surprised they didn't increase the level to 15 as well.. still time for more bad ideas I guess. Off to different game now... Should be 1 *

I've played this game for around 7 years, I used to love this game. It was fun and really enjoyable...until supercell decided to only go for the money and casted aside their players. Then, they tried to bring back people with evolutions and level 15. It is probably one of the worst ideas yet! Evolutions become overpowered as hell and level 15 is almost impossible to get free to play. Supercell is the Ubisoft of the mobile game genre, It's an utter disappointment to see what this game has become.

I used to buy the pass royale every month. It was a reasonable price. In this latest update they have hiked the price and give you less rewards. A terrible update no one asked for. I will be keeping my Play store balance for another game. The worst thing is I've only been playing for about 6 months and the game has gone downhill massively in such a short space.

It's brilliant as a game. Strategic, graphically attractive and really smooth. However it is the ultimate pay to win game and I'm sure thousands of kids are pumping money in to get the edge. It's enjoyable for free up until a point when you are constantly playing against people with an advantage, most likely from paying rather than playing for a long time.

It's a frustration when at certain points you are matched with cards that you don't have the slightest chance of winning. Obviously rigged for the golden players who pays the most, or sponsored players who advertise for the game. I don't mind all that, the only thing I mind is the "LAGGING". Don't tell me it's my network issue, because my internet is wired and 1 GBS

This game used to be a lot of fun, until it started to slowly become more and more pay to win. I had just recently upgraded my whole deck to level 13(the old max level) which costed pretty much all of my gold. Then they added level 14 to the game and it felt like leveling up my cards was a waste of time. Like, I already spent 500,000+ gold on maxing out my cards to level 13, and now I have to do it again? No thank you. Total Scam.

Great fun for 5 minutes at a time... Or more. If you are complaining about level it is because the rest of us have been playing for years. Grind it out like the rest of us. I have a ton of max cards and have spent very little money. If you feel like you have to "catch up" then spend it. The clash team has made an amazing balance between grind to play and pay to play. Better than most games!! I would like to see a maximum level difference of 1.5 that would calm all the complaints. 🤔👍

The games surprisingly fun and tactical and I've really taken to it despite disliking clash of clans pretty hard. BUT. There is no doubt in my mind that some of the cards are just ridiculously strong and some are perthectic for what they cost in exlier, I feel that there's some balancing issues with the cards that could be adjusted but what do I know. I'm just some guy.

Although I love this game I would have to give this four stars because sometimes you fight individuals who are in a higher level and have maxed out cards while you have level 11 cards. Thats a huge L. Also paying makes your life easier but i didnt really and im in challanger 3. The system is broken, but im still playing even though its been 3-4 years. So eh. 4/5 game. don't. play. if. you. get. mad. easily. But other than that yeah go for it. I got to say, the start of the game it is fun.

I was enjoying this game until the newest version was updated. It has this new mechanic where when you place a card either to attack or defend, at the most critical moment your player gets entangled by vines. The frustrating part is that this only ever happens to me. I've never once seen another player get cockblocked so brutally. Yeah, it's a real mood killer. I'm gonna have to uninstall if this keeps on happening

I return to the game occasionally, but it's clear it's still heavily focused on monetization. While enjoyable, the player base can be extremely toxic. The matchmaking often feels rigged, pairing you against opponents designed to counter your deck, almost guaranteeing a loss. Balance is practically non-existent, especially with the introduction of new, mostly paywalled features and gimmicks. If you're willing to spend money, go ahead. Otherwise, don't expect to progress very far.

Takes too long to open chests with only 4 slots available then fights have no benefits at all while you wait 8 hours for one chest to open and the others say there doing nowt. Watching the higher level replays there seems nothing to exciting to aspire to match their levels. Really not sure this is one of the better mobile games but I'm sure every update will bring something fun to the game. I'll wait and see.

This game could be fun. The value is at the most £9.99. All of that fun is sucked out of it by the gargantuan paywall. You have to wait to unlock battle rewards. You can only save four rewards at a time. Cards and in game currency, take an eternity to collect, probably 30 years or more. Any incentive they offer, gives you nothing as contents of chests are not guaranteed, matchmaking is so poor, clan wars are so poor, you lose 95% of the time.Or you could pay thousands to get a very slight gain.

I have been playing since the start, it is addictive and a great game. But.... i have to agree with most of the comments given. Play a certain deck and the match making will match you with some clever algorithm generated deck ruining your fun. wish it was random including only your own LVL.. Also thought it was memory problems making it crash but it would seem to be a bigger problem on their end. Update is not working so time to stop getting frustrated with the game I think and move on.

Its a great game overall. However, I do experience some difficulties during battle, for example: I get kicked out mid-game and I experience a lot of lag. I also get spammed after every match asking me to review, so I have. Other than that it is a brilliant game and I love playing it. Especially, with my Dad when we duel in friendly 1v1 clan matches.

Game was really fun at the start, but as you progress further you're kind of forced to spend money if you want to compete. Also 2v2 is one the best aspects of the game but its pointless when you don't get any rewards after the first few games unless you yet again spend money.... Please can you add more to the 2v2 aspect that isn't a cash grab and it would be a 5star rating

Designed to stop you when they want. Used to enjoy playing this but gave up a year or so ago. Started playing again recently and it's even worse. Never get cards you want/play all the time. Will only allow you to get so far then you're pitted against people 2 levels above so you just cannot win. Once your trophy count is down again, you start winning again. Uninstalled and will not make the mistake of returning again. Only way to progress at a reasonable rate is to buy the cards you want.

This is a fun card strategy game. The matchmaking can be a little dodgy at times but that's part of the experience in my opinion. And to those who say it's a pay to win, I and many of my friends are all 4000+ trophies without spending a penny. And to the others who find the game hard, there are many useful videos online about good decks and how to use them along with how to counter some of the harder to deal with cards. The 'tough' gameplay can be easily solved by YouTube.

Boring, pay to win. Predictable mis matching in a not so clever attempt to line people's pockets. Only way to progress is to empty your account and buy your way through. Or just play for the next 8/9 years and you'll be half way up the ranking. Too many players with zero skill just using inferno towers etc, because they aren't very good at the game. Would of been a good game if not for greed and bots

It would be higher. I am a champion player, played for just over a year. The game itself is really good, its a challange especially if you're underlevelled. The reason it's not higher is, over the year of playing it I noticed that instead of finding true balance in the cards they have now, they repeatedly bring out new cards quicker than they can balance the game. Every time you update, you break the game either in terms of having to sort out bugs that slow and lag the game out or an op card

Frustrating, annoying and ultimately dull game. The initial period of play is great, advancement is fast with lots of prizes and incentives along the way. Once this initial period is over progression becomes exceptionally slow or not at all. Your forces are improved randomly so playing the game doesn't mean it will get any better. Spending money only providers more random enhancements you're likely not to want. So playing means getting beaten endlessly by players avoiding the plateau, poor.

It's a very fun strategy game but it has a major problem for me at least, it is pay to win. I've been playing it for 3 years I have never spent a penny on it and I see the difference between me and my opponents / clan m8's that do actually spend money on the game. Besides that the developers are active, they always update it to keep the game fresh and I respect that.

Legit just a storefront with a game attached. Pass Royale, gems, and the lootboxes are not condusive to this style of strategy game in my opinion. Whilst there is some strategy within the deck-building, the vast majority of battles are determined by card and king levels, which always seems to be vastly unbalanced at higher leagues. This ends up in losses feeling frustrating and wins feeling meaningless. However, I do remember lower leagues being fun, and occasionaly you do get a balanced match.

It's a good fun game, fun art style and great tactical depth. I understand the need for in-app purchases fully, but this game really throws them down your throat at every opportunity and there's little in the way of safety net to stop you getting utterly trounced purely because you only paid $20 and the other guy paid $200. Really enjoying the game but there are more "balanced" experiences out there.

like most recent reviews, I've been playing and enjoying this game for years. But since the last update the slow creap of pay to win took a massive leap forward, so much so that players 3 levels below me had a full set of maxed cards. Coupled with the lag (that only seemed to happen against players that have paid) and the crashing, this game has become unplayable for those that don't want to spend a fortune to play.

Having placed since the day it launched, for years it felt addicting and fun, with the grind to higher trophies feeling rewarding, and I could physically tell I was getting better at the game mechanics. However after so long it no longer feels fresh, and it takes so long to upgrade cards that I haven't been able to develop any other deck than the same one I've been using for years.

I love the game and there is always something to do but I feel I've lost the insetive to play. Mainly because progression has slowed down at you get closer to max and the level curve is an issue. But the game is great. Personally the biggest issue is replay ability, the core game play of ladder is stale. And the progression. Attempting to funnel resources to your fav one deck is difficult,time consuming, feels like an impossible task and detrimental to other modes like clan wars.

I've been playing this regularly for a few years. It's been great to take a break from work, have a few battles, help the clan etc... except it's progressively become pay to win, and the evolution cards have taken away almost all the fun. You can be having a good, well balanced battle... then the evolution kicks in and there's no point any more. Oh well, perhaps it was time to move on anyway, so am uninstalling. Thanks for the good games, back in the day...

The game was fine until the discovery of 2v2 battles in challenge modes. I don't get to select the partner of my choice, and then I get one who either leaves the game or isn't as skilled as I am. This problem should be fixed as soon as possible as it makes no sense at all. I waste like 100 gems for the challenge by playing it again and what I get in return is nothing.

This is an awesome game but there is a massive bug that I'm not happy with.... I have come along way in the game, and I unlocked the Arena 2, then when I clicked battle, it wouldn't work, I was searching for opponents for 10 minutes and nothing would come up, then I pressed cancel and it did nothing! Fix this! Email me when u get this comment, thanks! <3

I have played this game for years hoping that it would improve. It has not. The match making algorithm has you climbing trophies to get close to 'rewards' then changes to make u drop all of the trophies and more. This happens on an hourly basis going up and down on the same but never making any progress. The matching making also seems to match u up with either player/bots that have no idea what they are doing or perfect counters either way waste of time playing this.

I left the game a year ago after playing for 3 years because it became unbalanced and really hard to have fun. I returned a few weeks ago because I hoped it had changed. It hasn't. At its core this is a great game. Fun, slick and easy to play free or paid. It has a great community too. The problem is some card combos just ruin the experience. I made it to challenger level and king level 13 and it doesn't change. Skill isn't rewarded as much as just playing the overpowered cards and winning.

Another great game, spoilt by greedy developers. This used to be a fun, casual game you could play when you get a spare minute. Now, it's completely pay to win with so many 'premium' options. Long time (8 years+) player, and this is the worst it's been. Matchmaking is also very bios once you get to a certain level, making it impossible to get further without using YouTube decks. Terrible game and nothing like it used to be.

Edit: 1 star can't even use the app UPDATE : I get fake notifications telling me chests have been unlocked, also the free chests icon sometimes shows more notification dots than there should be. There's no easy way to report bugs. The connection can be really poor, even on stable WiFi and 4G, recently I have noticed more and more connection dropouts. The re-connect system is poor, there needs to be a feature to help this along and give a 20-30 second window to the player that lost connection...

Game is getting worse. Very quick. You have to spend money if you want to win and if you don't you get hard stuck, making the game horrible to play. You don't make progress without spending money, and now with the addition of the diamond pass, giving low level players incredibly powerful and unfair cards makes it almost impossible to progress. The only way to progress is by using pathetic, sad, low skill decks, or spend around 12-15 £/€/$ a month. Theyre killing the game because they want money.

Don't waste your time downloading this app unless you are willing to pay the monthly prescription. When I first got it over 3 years ago it was OK but it has slowly turned into all about paying each month to get the best cards those that don't pay are just in it to make the premium players feel good for justifying the cost is think this game is almost turned into a form of gambling as you are required to pay money not knowing what you will get in return it is very addictive.

This game is very good and fun when it works. Almost every time I load into a match, the game freezes and crashes. Then after about half an hour, I can finally do the things I want to do. I'm playing this on an LG K20. Aside from this relatively large issue, the game is very fun, with charming graphics and excellent multiplayer gameplay. The clans are very useful for connecting with friends too.

TWICE, when i went on hog draft race, it crashed. The first time, it was stuck at 81% for a few minutes. The second time, it froze a few moments in. The third time I played, the openent got FAR superior cards to me, but that is a different story. My main concern is that out of three loses, in only one did I even have what was even classable as a chance.

Has potential to be a truly great game, but has been ruined by bad design, only possible to succeed by buying in game currency, mechanics to earn currency in game amount to too little, too late, bullied by those who do spend hard cash, ........ This review originally written in 2018 and while its now easier to gain common cards, the real game winning cards are too rare to collect and gold to upgrade them is painfully slow without spending hard cash.

Eh what can I say that hasn't already been said for the many games that are just like this? You fight PvP, join a group and use a 'wars' mechanic. There's a premium pass you pay for that gets you better loot and skins, and it's a free game so wait timers are its bread and butter. This one has cards you collect to level up troops, which isn't original but is at least interesting- I can at least see why some people buy the premium currency. Overall okay but I wouldn't waste money on it.

This game has turned upside down. One of the worst outcomes possible. I've been playing since the beta, and the game has gotten worse with every update. Clearly this is nothing but a cash cow to the developers. Every new card or evolution they release, they make sure it is overpowered so you spend money to upgrade/get it, especially with the exclusive shop offers, which are way too overpriced btw, to make people spend their money. Worst example of greed possible. Avoid as a new player.

I used to love this game however whenever I load into my first ever game for the day, the match takes forever to load and by the time it has loaded it fast forwards where it turns out the enemy has already destroyed one of my towers. However this does not happen again until the next time I shut the game and load it again. My internet is good as all my other games are fine as are the other matches so it isnt the problem and rather it's something supercell need to fix. Nerf the Electro Ram too.

The second the game made 2v2 less relevant, I immediately lost interest. The only ties I had left to this game were just ripped away in a single update. The fanbase is more divided than ever about level 15 and the introduction of yet another pass (which is just a cash grab anyways for play-to-win players). This game won't have much left to give soon enough for the average player, just like many other games nowadays. RIP Clash Royale, you were once just harmless fun, now you've lost your way.

Game is fun climbing initially, then ends up being very unfun and unfair in so many ways. 80% of the time, matchmaking (after a certain point in the game) is just blatantly unfair, putting you up against level 14 king towers whilst you're level 11. At this point you can either continue in a rut, farming gold at a rate of at most maybe 400-500 per 8 hours until you max out your cards, or you can just pay to win. NO-ONE picks the former.

Great until now, have been playing this game for over 3 years and could not be any more disappointed. I now lose more crowns against a level 13 (I'm level. 12) then i win against a level 13, I'm not sure if this is a bug in the game but it needs to get fixed ASAP. Trying to get xp is harder then anything I've been stuck of level 12 for over a year and I'm just halfway to 13. Please fix these bugs soon.

Opponent matching is ridiculous, I played this game almost every day for over a year, then deleted it, after a year or so I thought I'd give it another go, that was 2 days ago, and it's still as bad, you get matched against "people" or maybe bots who seem to know what deck you have, and can counter you every time, it's extremely frustrating, so it's being deleted again.

The game makes no sense to me. You are soooo limited in how many fights you can fight. You earn chests, to unlock them, you have to wait 3,8, or 12 hours and can maximum hold 4 cheast at a time. So, as soon as you have 4, it makes no sense to keep fighting since you earn no more chests. So you have to wait and wait. For now, i do 1 fight every 3 to 8 hours. Total nonsense!!!!!! Instead of making you come back, the devs make you stay away.

Tried to like it... but it's Hateful... Playing games constantly with people spamming units always on demand, always higher levels and constantly playing games with people who have the ability to launch 3 units at once and faster elixir. I tried to like the game but it is designed to wind you up to pay to win. I reached level 10 and I was put against people with much higher units (12 or 13) as standard. Nothing says getting beat by higher level units constantly to make you button a game.

Used to be good. Since adding championship characters they're really milking the users for money. Played for 5 years, got to max level on most cards, now I'm uninstalling because it will take another 3 years to get max level again. Play something else that isn't all about making money. It's not a good game if you want to take it seriously and get a high rank. You're 5 years too late to even have a chance

The game is really good cool and addictive. However the hunter is to op (over powered) like I deploy a skeleton army and it's gone with in milliseconds. It needs to be nerfed to either only hitting land or sky opponents or up the loot thing to 7or even get rid of it would be nice.it's to mad otherwise. hitting at 350 damage per second that's 700 damage every 2 seconds. a lot. Also the clock thing needs to improve because I'll be deploying a skeleton army and it just Goes. So should only be able to see or even hit in till the time has completed to deploy it to max. Very good game though. impressive. Lucky gave it 4 stars.

Mixed feelings - Have had the game 7 years and it appears to just be more pay to win, cheapening the experience, you reach max level and they move the bar up again. Not really enjoyable anymore. Also the game is huge and I feel like every update I need to remove and find more storage. So unfortunately I've now uninstalled both Clash of Clans and Royale. Cheers guys, hope you realise you've ruined it.

It's normally fun but they purposely let you progress into an arena (where you are under leveled) very easily so you cannot progress without spending money to upgrade. At this point you are forced to pay out or grind the season shops for the better part of a year to even gain one level in your deck. You cannot go down arenas after progressing, getting you stuck somewhere progression is impossible. I would recommend to those who have money to spend on the game, Ur don't bother otherwise.

Horrible game. Came back after not playing for a while just to be absolutely constantly destroyed because other person always had higher level troops. No matter what strategy I tried, what videos I watched and what I did about it I always lost. I even let someone who is much higher trophies than me play with my available cards and they still lost every battle. Rigged game and matchmaking is horrible. Uninstall.

Salty doesn't cut it. In 2020 I reviewed 5* and addictive fun. The gameplay hasn't changed much. The saltiness comes from the seasonal pass changes that on my opinion were unnecessary. I will just flatly not be paying £11.99 for rewards I was getting for under £5 just 2 days ago. On top of that, you removed the best items, books and coins from the pass. Legitimately quitting after the season ends if the changes aren't reverted. The mo ey grab is ridiculous. Thanks for the last 5 years guys...

After winning a few matches this game will match you with someone who has clearly paid to level their cards up. It takes a solid 10 seconds to scroll past all the paid offers in the shop to the things you can buy with in-game currency. Absolutely ludicrous. The game itself is pretty good and that can't be denied at all - if it wasn't p2w it would be perfect. The matching between players is rigged against those who are f2p and puts you against higher levels. Why, if there are players your level?!

Used to play 10 years ago, havent plaued in five so decided to redownload, the whole card system was hundreds of times better before. Not to mention my account was reset to zero for some reason when I spent years on that account. Honestly disgusting. Not to mention the fact that you dont get chests anymore for doing battles? What? That was the only reason to keep playing because that was how you progressed. To any returning players, save yourself the time and dont waste a minute on this game.

1. You really need to add new characters to the season. 2. Many players have no place for growth. Up the coin cap from 5 million. 3. Why working on banners is a priority is beyond me... 4.Star points add no value... 5. Only a few champions. 6. War is getting boaring I would really like to see more units different from classes and variety... I'm really struggling to play this game. This used to be a fun game.

been playing for about a year or so now, but recent updates are making it very rarely get past the initial loading screen. When it has, the game has crashed multiple times. I've put money into gems and stuff so it's kinda annoying to not even be able to play a match some days. Have tried uninstalling and reinstalling as well as multiple phone restarts.

I have a few thousand trophies, but now I am stuck because I am going against level 14 and 15 decks when I only have level 11. Too pay to win even the content creators tell you not to buy anything because of the horrible value. My friend has been playing for 2 years, and he has been stuck at 7 thousand trophies for 1 year because of this. I would change my rating if it was more free to play friendly but until then my rating is not changing from 2 star. Thanks for reading if u made it this far!

This game was brilliant. However, they have kept tweaking it until they've ruined it. Since the last update on the 05/12, it's just been geared towards being a cash cow. Games are more difficult, most things require gems, both parties now require exchange tokens etc. In my own personal opinion, they have scored an own goal with the latest update. I've played this game for well over 2 years, but ill probably look to leave the game due to this update.

I think this game is amazing; I am addicted to it! 😊 There are a few problems with the game though that I think should be fixed. Whenever I *accidently* click Battle, I quickly try to cancel it, however it never seems to work... 😯 Also, you need to bring DRAFT BATTLE back! It gives players an opportunity to work with other cards that they have never used before. I think the addition of Spooky Town is great, but I'm not pleased with how the cards keep moving up arenas. 😕 Thanks for reading! 😉

i retried this game after not playing for several years, it used to be an interesting game but sadly unless you're prepared to spend (serious amounts of) money the progression is non existent now and getting to a point where you can compete is simply unattainable. The goalposts seemingly get moved away further and put behind more and more pay walls every update for the 3 months I played after coming back.

My experience has not been to good. The game is all about deception......Against the players. They are giving you a good experience at first. They show you how many levels there are, with no chance of reaching them. That's when the fun begins, they offer all these great deals and chances of progression.........it never happens. If you don't have good internet speed. DON'T PLAY THIS GAME.

still at its core an incredible game with great gameplay loop and replayability. Unfortunately, the past few years have shown supercell to be money-hungry and uncaring of the player experience. the free-to-play grind to own even a single playable deck is now pretty much impossible, and Evolutions have damaged the core gameplay to what is probably an irreparable amount. I still have hope that supercell might turn this trend round, and i stay up to date on its development just in case, one day..

Pretty good game. I hear everyone crying about pay to win, but I've spent under 5 pounds on the game and I'm at 6300 trophies with level 12 and 13 troops, and win most battles. The only bad things is the boat clan wars. Whoever put that in game needs to be set alight. And the fact that the cancel button has a 95% fail rate, forcing me to battle even if I cancel. Apart from these, very good game

It a normal game where either someone enjoys it alot or doesn't, it's not fair in most situations but that makes it challenging sometimes and other times you can't really defeat your opponent because they're two or three levels higher than you which in the upper tiers is alot of difference in ability and cards, altogether play it at your own risk because you'll get tilted or even rage at some point but still play for the fun of it not for anything else ^^

Latest big update killed the game for me, and as someone who played on-and-off for 7 years, I'm telling you its not worth starting from scratch. Since the removal of chests and season store the devs removed the incentive to play for free. I get that the game always promoted to buy stuff but now its a requirement, not a choice, if you want to progress.

Played for years, was a good game to start off with BUT as time has gone on, I find it's definitely rigged for you to lose, the matchmaking isnt random,many times I've lost to certain decks then been matched over and over with the same deck, the game can get quite repetitive and boring and some players do take it a bit to seriously, if hadn't spent so much money trying to level up my cards ,I would happily delete it from my devices, leveling up the cards doesn't make you win, it's how you play,

This game is incredibly addictive, but it's made even more frustrating by a slew of microtransactions that push you to upgrade, or risk the inevitable frustration of facing players with much higher-level cards. It also simulates the experience of a casino slot machine, with random loot boxes that contain unpredictable rewards. I was stuck at 7k trophies for a long time, unable to progress, constantly matched against opponents with stronger decks (level 14 cards +).

Iv played this game for 6 years across multiple accounts. The game is impossible to play unless you buy battle passes and chests and gems etc. The game is quite fun in the early stages as everyone is around the same strength but as soon as you get to 4500 trophies or above you will encounter more often that not enemies who's decks are filled with cards 3 levels higher than yours, resulting in such a large power difference that they can spam with no statergy and still win. I will be deleting now.

A great game However, late game, it can get very frustrating. This is because there is not enough to do for a long amount of time. If you play ladder (the main competitive gamemode) for a long period of time, the matchmaking becomes hard. There is not much else to do that seems fun, relatively balanced, and still rewarding. IMO this is down to a few mistakes by the dev team in a row (ie. Trophy change, CW2), but they are mistakes. Overall; 5☆ for early - mid game late game lets it down to a 3.5☆

Whenever I try get into an online match, the game just kicks me, and most of the time I lose because of that. It's a shame, cos this game is good otherwise, but I can't join a clan with my friends cos I can't get any trophies cos of the problem from earlier. Edit: Now I can't even be in the app for a good couple of minutes without being kicked, it's now become unplayable.

It's a fun and addicting game. I would give it more stars but I feel like it's not there with the matchmaking. You will constantly battle someone higher than you which can be very frustrating. I'm level 12 now so have put many hours into the game, but I will forever go against level 13, which doesn't sound bad being 1 higher, but in a game like this it is everything. They need to rework the matchmaking a bit, but other than that it's fun to play.

Worst customer service ever (as bad as instagram which has no customer service) but a fun game. Ive lost 87% of the games Ive played in the past few days so it's frustrating to say the least. I was paired to a 4900 trophy account when I was playing on my 1600 trophy account, and when on my main account, Im paired against people with all their cards maxed. All the game reminds me of now is how frustrating it was back during launch when I was stuck in arena 2 for two whole years.

The general idea for the game is good, but it's so poorly executed. It's a complete cash grab. Certain cards are broken via general stats (e.g. bowler or valkyrie, gay barbarians, or lumberjack) or simply through mechanics (mega gay, gay giant, freeze) The game is broken to the point it doesn't even take skill. As long as your opponent has at least ONE of those cards mentioned, you've lost. There's no way to win. Don't install - don't waste your time.

I’m going to get the praise out of the way, I love this game, I’ve played it since release and have even spent real money on the game when there has been offers on...I draw the line at spending more than the cost of a retail game though. The game is basically interactive chess but you choose the pieces you have, risk vs reward, high elixir beat down deck vs fast cycle squishy deck. The depth of the game is insane. My issue comes with the balance of the game. Supercell work hard to make sure

Played this game for a long time now and have mixed feelings about the game. The overall concept of the game is good and that's why I still play it. However it's lost the feeling of fun for me. Unless you dump £££ into the game the grind to lvl up cards is very long The new lvl 14 towers and champions bring new things to the game but aimed at getting more cash from players who do spend if we're being honest about it.

Recently came back after not playing for a while, but would strongly not recommend the game after the current update. If you are not willing to pay a ridiculous amount then you're no longer going to see any meaningful progress to your card levels and will be at a significant disadvantage. Sad to see. Uninstalled and not worth the time now

Really good game. Been playing it since it first came out. But since the last update, literally all my games freeze half way through the match. My collection battles, war battles, drafts. Literally all of them. My phone is up to date and the game is up to date as well so I don't see where the issue is apart from the game. Can't play this game anymore and I'm really sad since it's a game I really like. Until this gets fixed I won't be playing the game anymore.
